title: Environmental Data Cube for Oglala Lakota
purpose: Support the agricultural sustainability assessment of BIA-leased lands on the Pine Ridge Indian Reservation

components.spatial_support: Annual environmental time series; variable-specific spatial support
Parcel-level Landsat, reservation-scale EVI, climate context

integration_principle: Preserve distinct spatial and temporal support for each observation source
interpretation_limitations: Remote sensing observations do not independently establish grazing causation
Parcel-level Landsat and reservation-scale MODIS EVI are not spatially interchangeable
Climate observations are contextual; original geographic support is unverified
Field validation is required for independent assessment of land conditions
